description: One small round bronze and golden achievement medal UI icon, a cream five-point star embossed in its circular face, two short brown ribbons below, front view. Match warm brown wooden cream parchment fishing-game interface. Single isolated icon centered, crisp clean 16-bit pixel art, 3 shades per color, dark brown one-pixel contour, clear silhouette readable at 20 pixels, transparent background, 4 pixel transparent margin on every edge, no shadow cast outside object, no panel, no background scene.
color_palette: dark brown outline, warm tan and brass gold, cream highlights
